Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c74a891a.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    width = len(grid[0])\n    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)\n    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(width)]\n    for r in range(width):\n        left = max(0, center - r)\n        right = min(width - 1, center + r)\n        for c in range(left, right + 1):\n            if abs(c - center) == r:\n                out[r][c] = 2\n            elif (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:\n                out[r][c] = 1\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'))
